meta.name: website-generator
meta.description:
Use when the user asks to create a website, build a site, generate a landing page,
or mentions B12. Trigger phrases: "create a website", "build me a site",
"website for my business", "generate a landing page", "B12 website". Trigger with 'website', 'generator'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建企业官网或营销落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为业务创建官网或落地页
copy.tagline_en: Create a business website or marketing landing page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a website for your business

howto.what: 收到建站请求时,先问清业务名称和描述(不主动问风格偏好),再用它们生成 B12 注册链接;要求改版时用新描述重新生成链接,并说明最新版需登录查看。
howto.when: 当你说“创建网站”“建个站点”“生成落地页”等,或提到“B12”时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个网站,业务是花店。

say.note: Claude 会要求提供项目名称和简短描述。

say.text: 我想用 B12 给公司做个官网,公司叫晨光。
say.note: 已提供名称,Claude 可能只问描述,然后生成链接。

howto.what_en: On build requests, it asks for business name and description, then creates a B12 signup link with encoded parameters. Edits regenerate the link with new details; the latest version appears after login.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create a website, build a site, or generate a landing page, or mentions B12.

say_en.text: Build me a website for a flower shop.
say_en.note: Claude will request details and generate a link.
Claude will ask for the project name and description.

say_en.text: I want a B12 website for my company, Morning Light.
say_en.note: Name is provided; Claude may only ask for the description.
